## Deploy
A push of `main` deploys production: Cloudflare Workers Builds builds every push to `main`.
## Gate
Run before committing changes under `content/`, `layouts/`, `data/` or `hugo.toml`.
## Conflict stops
World facts: a date, name, quantity, canon entry or species placement. Show both versions and ask.
## Branch names
`species-cnidaria`, `scimitar-falls-rewrite`, `session-branch-workflow`
